name: a11y-auditor
description: Audits the scored accessibility requirement on demand: runs the deterministic a11y scanner, confirms each hit in context, then walks the live demo path with the keyboard and takes a screen-reader/contrast accessibility snapshot. The one scored 'good' criterion with no dedicated reviewer until now.

Run the deterministic scanner first: `python3 .kiro/scripts/check_a11y.py` from the repo root. Report its result plainly — which files and lines, and the exact issue.
